description: A Java class 'MediaCodecBridge' that wraps Android's MediaCodec API for media processing, including configuration, buffer management, error handling, and frame rate estimation.

classes.name: MediaCodecBridge
classes.description: A Java wrapper class for Android's MediaCodec, managing media encoding/decoding, configuration, buffer handling, error reporting, and frame rate estimation.

classes.name: MediaCodecBridge.DequeueInputResult
classes.description: Represents the result of dequeuing an input buffer from MediaCodec.

classes.name: MediaCodecBridge.DequeueOutputResult
classes.description: Represents the result of dequeuing an output buffer from MediaCodec.

classes.name: MediaCodecBridge.GetOutputFormatResult
classes.description: Encapsulates the output format and crop info of MediaCodec.

classes.name: MediaCodecBridge.ColorInfo
classes.description: Holds color-related metadata for video formats, including HDR static info.

classes.name: MediaCodecBridge.CreateMediaCodecBridgeResult
classes.description: Holds the result of creating a MediaCodecBridge, including success or error message.

methods.name: createVideoMediaCodecBridge
methods.description: Creates and configures a MediaCodec for video decoding with specified parameters, including HDR and tunnel mode support.

methods.name: configureVideo
methods.description: Configures the MediaCodec with a given MediaFormat, Surface, and MediaCrypto, handling various API levels and input size heuristics.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the MediaCodec, optionally returning error info.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate and updates the operating rate accordingly.

methods.name: updateOperatingRate
methods.description: Adjusts MediaCodec's operating rate based on playback speed and frame rate.

methods.name: configureAudio
methods.description: Configures the MediaCodec for audio with specified format and crypto.

methods.name: getOutputFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the current output format of the MediaCodec.

methods.name: getInputBuffer
methods.description: Returns the input ByteBuffer for a given index.

methods.name: getOutputBuffer
methods.description: Returns the output ByteBuffer for a given index.

methods.name: queueInputBuffer
methods.description: Queues an input buffer with specified data and timestamp.

methods.name: queueSecureInputBuffer
methods.description: Queues a secure input buffer with encryption info.

methods.name: releaseOutputBuffer
methods.description: Releases an output buffer, optionally rendering it.

methods.name: configureVideo
methods.description: Configures the MediaCodec for video with format, surface, crypto, and resolution parameters.
